use default

let level = [
    "#######",
    "#     #",
    "#     #",
    "#. #  #",
    "#. $$ #",
    "#.$$  #",
    "#.#  @#",
    "#######"
]

let width = level[0].length
let cells = level |> join("")

let goals =
    (0..cells.length) |> filter(i => cells[i] == '.') |> collect_list()

let moves = [
    (step = -1, name = 'l'),
    (step = -width, name = 'u'),
    (step = 1, name = 'r'),
    (step = width, name = 'd')
]

use State = (player: int, boxes: string, path: string)

put(text: string, at: int, value: char) -> string =>
    text.remove(at, 1).insert(at, "{value}")

solve() -> string? is
    let start = cells.index_of('@')
    let initial = cells.replace('@', ' ').replace('.', ' ')

    let seen = SET[string]()
    let queue = Collections.Queue[State]()

    seen.add("{start}:{initial}")
    queue.enqueue((player = start, boxes = initial, path = ""))

    while queue.count > 0 do
        let (player, boxes, path) = queue.dequeue()

        if goals |> all(g => boxes[g] == '$') then
            return path
        fi

        for (step, name) in moves do
            let next = player + step
            let beyond = next + step
            let pushed = boxes[next] == '$'

            let blocked =
                cells[next] == '#' \/
                (pushed /\ (cells[beyond] == '#' \/ boxes[beyond] == '$'))

            if blocked then
                continue
            fi

            let after =
                if pushed then put(put(boxes, next, ' '), beyond, '$')
                else boxes
                fi

            if seen.add("{next}:{after}") then
                let move =
                    if pushed then char.to_upper(name) else name fi

                queue.enqueue(
                    (player = next, boxes = after, path = "{path}{move}"))
            fi
        od
    od

    return null
si

for row in level do
    write_line(row)
od

write_line(solve() ?? "no solution")
